description: Make a printable chart for children and families: chore chart, reward (sticker) chart, potty training chart, behavior chart, visual schedule, first-then board, morning or bedtime routine chart, or habit tracker. Steps and chores get matching pictures automatically. Give names to print one chart per child (chore, reward and behavior charts; in the chat only).

days.description: Chore and behavior charts: week (7 days) or school (5).

decoration.description: A themed border with matching pictures, drawn around the sheet: "line" for a plain border, "none" for nothing, or a theme such as halloween, christmas, thanksgiving, spring, dinosaurs, space, ocean, animals, birthday, back-to-school (95 themes; find_printables shows a theme’s name). Leave out for no border.

dyslexia_font.description: Print in OpenDyslexic, a typeface some readers with dyslexia find easier.

goal.description: Reward and behavior charts: the goal, e.g. "Use the potty" or "Kind hands".

items.description: The chores (up to 12), schedule or routine steps (up to 12), behavior periods (up to 8, e.g. "Morning"), or habits (up to 15). Reward charts take a goal instead.

layout.description: Visual schedule only: strip, list, first_then or cards (for a first-then board, use kind first_then).

month.description: Habit tracker: the month to start, 1 to 12.

names.description: Optional names, one chart each (first names are enough). Shown and printed in the chat only: like the site, the link never carries names, so a person opening the link types them on the page.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, the default; US and Canada) or a4 (everywhere else).

pictures.description: Chore chart and schedules: a picture for each item (on by default).

reward.description: Reward chart: what the child earns, e.g. "A trip to the park". Chore and behavior charts: any text turns on a reward line.

seed.description: Which random version to make. Leave out for a fresh one; pass the seed from an earlier result to keep that version while changing other settings.

spaces.description: Reward chart: how many spaces to fill.

title.description: The title printed at the top of the sheet, e.g. "My Chores". Keep it short.

week_starts.description: The first day of the week.

name: make_chart

maker.description: Which maker drew it, e.g. wordSearch

notes.description: Things worth knowing about this sheet

playUrl.description: Where a child can solve it on a screen (word search, crossword, maze, sudoku)

seed.description: The seed that rebuilds this exact sheet

settings.description: The address settings, as the maker reads them

url.description: The sheet on printablesmith.com, every setting filled in: open it to adjust, download the PDF or print

title: Chart for home or class
